tools.name: get_clip
tools.description: A looping 3D video (MP4) of one Hawaiʻi lot by TMK, the lot swinging left and right with its lot line on the ground, drawn from USGS lidar. Returns a download link that works for a day. Free: 1 clip a month. More with ParcelSheet Pro ($22 a month).

tools.name: get_public_records
tools.description: Answers whether one Hawaiʻi lot has a county tax sale notice (is this TMK on the tax sale list) and what building permits have been pulled for it. County tax sale notices and building permits for one TMK, each with its source. ParcelSheet Pro ($22 a month) only.
